## Drop In

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/drop-in/overview): A correctly configured Drop-in UI integration with [PayPal](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/paypal/overview) enabled is presented below.
- [Setup and Integration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/drop-in/setup-and-integration/): To use the Drop-in UI, you'll need to or you can on your server. This will be your authorization used when creating Drop-in.
- [Customization](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/drop-in/customization/): If you pass a when Drop-in will display that customer's saved payment methods and automatically add any newly-entered payment methods to their Vault record.
